articles.title: Crypto wallet SafePal reveals a data breach exposing nearly 40,000 customers' order info
articles.snippet: While the data breach exposed the personal order details of thousands of customers, all private keys, seed phrases, and crypto assets remain completely safe.

articles.title: Apple Turns to Alibaba to Help Build AI Model for China
articles.snippet: Apple is pairing its in-house model with Alibaba’s Qwen as it prepares to bring Apple Intelligence to Chinese iPhones.
